title: Requesting Urgent Help and Giving a Location
context: 虚构的美国场景：Maya 在虚构的 Willow Falls 市 Pine Park 东门附近看到一人倒在地上，拨打 911。接线员 Alex 核对位置和虚构回拨号码，请她留在线上听从指引。本对话仅为语言练习片段，并非完整的紧急调度流程；真实紧急情况请拨打当地紧急号码并遵循接线员指示。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I need urgent help. Someone is lying on the ground at Pine Park on Oak Street in Willow Falls.
dialogue.zh: 我需要紧急帮助。有人倒在 Willow Falls 市 Oak Street 上 Pine Park 的地上。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: I am the dispatcher. Where in Pine Park on Oak Street are you?
dialogue.zh: 我是接线员。你在 Oak Street 上 Pine Park 的什么位置？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I am just inside the east gate, beside the red information sign.
dialogue.zh: 我在东门内侧，就在红色信息牌旁边。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Just inside the east gate beside the red sign, correct?
dialogue.zh: 就在东门内侧的红色牌子旁边，对吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes, that is correct. The person is not speaking to me.
dialogue.zh: 是的，没错。那个人没有和我说话。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Help is being sent. What number can we call you back on?
dialogue.zh: 救援正在派出。我们可以用哪个号码回拨给你？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes. I am still beside the east gate.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Please stay on the line and listen to my instructions.
dialogue.zh: 请不要挂断电话，听我的指示。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I will stay on the line. Please tell me what to do.
dialogue.zh: 我会保持通话。请告诉我该怎么做。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: I am here with you. Keep listening while help is on the way.
dialogue.zh: 我会一直和你通话。救援赶来时请继续听我说。

expressions.zh: 我需要紧急帮助，用于清楚说明求助目的。
expressions.example: I need urgent help at the park.

expressions.zh: 就在东门内侧，说明相对于入口的位置。
expressions.example: I am just inside the east gate.

expressions.zh: 在牌子旁边，用醒目标志辅助定位。
expressions.example: We are beside the red sign.

expressions.zh: 给你回拨，用于确认可联系的号码。
expressions.example: What number can we call you back on?

pronunciation: urgent 重音在第一音节 /ˈɝːdʒənt/；location 重音在第二音节 /loʊˈkeɪʃən/。朗读号码时逐个数字说清楚，并停顿核对。

practice.title: Part 1 · Giving a location
practice.prompt: How would you describe where you are in an unfamiliar place?
practice.answer: I would look for an entrance, a street name, or a clear sign. Then I would describe my position beside it.

practice.title: Part 2 · Asking for help
practice.prompt: Describe an imagined situation where you need urgent help in a public place. Explain what you would say and how you would give your location.
practice.answer: In an imaginary situation, I am near the entrance of a public park and see someone lying on the ground. I call the local emergency service and clearly ask for help. I give the park name, the entrance, and a nearby sign. I describe only what I can observe and give a callback number when asked. I stay on the line and listen carefully to the dispatcher. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Clear communication
practice.prompt: Why is a precise location useful when asking for urgent help?
practice.answer: A precise location can help responders find the caller. Repeating a landmark or entrance gives both people a chance to correct a misunderstanding.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读，再完成口头练习。
practice.answer: 用四到六句请求帮助，说明可观察情况、入口和标志，复述虚构回拨号码并表示会听从接线员指导。
